description: Experiment51: three adjacent paired comparisons of cumulative reachability variants. before->skip omits calls while nodes remain; skip->verdict uses borrowed TopologyState and computes only the dead predicate; verdict->early moves that same predicate after propagation and before dynamic SCC. Common instrumentation in all four builds. Eight paired repeats per primary workload, four per cross-cache and small control. AB/BA balanced within OFF cells; fixed-seed random pair order. Hotspot-OFF whole-solve timing is primary; 24 ON diagnostic jobs are separate. Twelve stress records may cap, with no completion speedup claim. All other jobs must finish and match full public results, layout-key sets, preferred witnesses and proof. Early pruning may legitimately change stage-owned counters. User explicitly authorized up to eight hours for all three tests. 312 jobs: 22560s search + 4680s cleanup = 27240s (7.57h), reserving 1560s for orchestration. Retain every adverse pair; small effects require uncertainty reporting and no automatic promotion.
